title: schema_transform step configuration (architecture section 4)
description: Field mapping: rename, cast, flatten, drop, null handling. A mapping entry either maps 'from' to 'to' with a neutral 'type' (a rename, a cast, or both), or drops 'from' with 'drop: true' and names no target. 'type' is shaped loosely here (string or object); the neutral-type system itself -- the fixed scalar set, decimal precision/scale, and estate-enabled structured types -- is enforced once, in ergasterion/framework/declaration.py, not duplicated across schema files.
